LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANTS FAWZI ZEIDAN, MARILYN ZEIDAN, CINDY ZEIDAN'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT OR IN THE ALTERNATIVE SUMMARY ADJUDICATION OF ISSUES. MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT IS DENIED. THERE ARE TRIABLE ISSUE OF MATERIAL FACT AS TO WHEN PLAINTIFF'S ACQUIRED ACTUAL OR CONSTRUCTIVE NOTICE OF THE CLAIMED OPTION IN LIGHT OF THE GIANNINI DECLARATION AND ISSUES CONCERNING WHEN ARRIAZA'S AGENCY ENDED; AS TO THE EXTENT OF ANY PREJUDICE TO DEFENDANT'S FROM WHATEVER DELAY OCCURRED; AND AS TO WHETHER ANY SUCH DELAY HAS BEEN UNREASONABLE IN LIGHT OF ALL THE CIRCUMSTANCES. THE MOTION FOR SUMMARY ADJUDICATION IS DENIED BECAUSE IT WOULD NOT DISPOSE OF AN ENTIRE CAUSE OF ACTION. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO PREPARE A FORM OF ORDER PURSUANT TO CCP 437 C(G). JUDGE: PETER J.
